messages:
miguel-sales: Heads-up — Zenith Global (PO PO-88921) says the Q3 promo credit Sales added didn’t show up on their Aug invoice. Customer called upset, wants manual adjustment and line-note on the invoice.

sarah-cs: Thanks, Miguel. Can you paste the invoice number and the exact promo code the AE used? Also need billing account id.

miguel-sales: Invoice INV-2026-08-4372, billing-id BG-7789, promo code ZENITH-Q3-ENTERPRISE. Sales recorded a $25,000 contract credit on the deal memo (see PO), but invoice total is unchanged.

alex-support: Reproduced on our side — invoice shows full charge. Checking billing ledger; looks like promo code set as "contract_note" on the sales record, not as an applied credit transaction.

billing-bot: auto-note: Promo code ZENITH-Q3-ENTERPRISE present on customer contract but no matching CreditTransaction record (search_token: BG-7789). Ticket CR-84219 created.

ryan-finance: I can do a manual credit but need: 1) copy of PO, 2) confirmation from Sales that amount is approved, 3) text to include on invoice. Who has final sign-off?

miguel-sales: Jen (jennie-se) signed the addendum; she confirmed via email at 2025-08-05 15:02. Attaching PO and email to the ticket now. Approve for $25,000.

sarah-cs: Steps I took to repro: 1) open billing UI -> accounts/BG-7789 -> invoices -> INV-2026-08-4372 2) click "view adjustments" -> empty. 3) API query: `GET /v1/accounts/BG-7789/invoices/INV-2026-08-4372` returns invoice_json with total_cents: 12500000. No adjustments array.

alex-support: Quick CLI dump for ops if helpful:
```
$ rdb billing get-invoice --account BG-7789 --invoice INV-2026-08-4372 
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-08-4372",
  "total_cents": 12500000,
  "adjustments": []
}
```

ryan-finance: Okay I will create a manual CreditTransaction for $25,000 and attach PO/contract note. Will include line: "Sales promo credit per PO PO-88921 — ZENITH-Q3-ENTERPRISE". I’ll flag it as non-recurring.

jennie-se: Confirmed — please include the contract clause reference: Section 2.1(b) and add note: "Invoice adjustment requested by Sales per executed PO." Sales approves.

ryan-finance: Done. Credit transaction CR-84219-ADJ created and applied to INV-2026-08-4372 for 2500000 cents. Snapshot: https://internal.redwood/billing/adjustments/CR-84219-ADJ (internal link). I also added the invoice note: "Applied $25,000 credit per PO PO-88921 (ZENITH-Q3-ENTERPRISE)."

sarah-cs: I can see the credit in billing UI now; invoice balance shows 0 due. Customer notified and asked for updated PDF.

miguel-sales: Customer confirmed receipt of updated invoice PDF and is happy. Can we ask Sales Ops to update the CRM record so future billing runs include the contract credit mapping?

alex-support: Filing a follow-up internal ticket to Sales Ops: SO-5304 — map ZENITH-Q3-ENTERPRISE to automatic adjustment rules.

sarah-cs: Closing this thread after Sales Ops ticket created and finance adjustment applied. Marking as resolved. :white_check_mark:
